tests.reason: Untestable (no setup): at shipped defaults Ghostty 1.4.0 on macOS raises nothing a run can read when OSC 133;D arrives, so the cell is undecidable without a user config change. Traced in tag v1.4.0 (SHA256 d692bb9b): src/terminal/osc.zig:1180 parses 133, the exit code is an option of that parser (src/terminal/osc/parsers/semantic_prompt.zig:77-111), src/terminal/stream_terminal.zig:918-965 passes it to the effect callback, src/termio/stream_handler.zig:1475-1508 turns end_command into stop_command at :1493, and src/Surface.zig:1198-1225 emits command_finished with the exit code and the measured duration. The Mac app returns immediately on the shipped default: macos/Sources/Ghostty/Ghostty.App.swift:1642-1712 reads notifyOnCommandFinish and returns when it is never (src/config/Config.zig:1214), the action defaults to bell without notify (:1228) behind a five-second floor (:1265), and only a user setting that gate reaches the bell or a UNUserNotificationCenter banner (:1599,:1620) outside the text cells and window screenshot the run measures. The D mark and the A/B/C cycle are stored as row content, visible only to the debug inspector (src/inspector/widgets/page.zig:291 via src/input/Binding.zig:688-691) and the snapshot serializer (src/terminal/snapshot/grid.zig:259), neither of which is a default-launch reader. The only readback route needs notify-on-command-finish set away from never, which changes what Ghostty does when a command ends (a bell or a notification banner), so it is a behaviour setting, not an observer-only switch (@cto 9de3bba2).

tests.reason: Untestable (no setup): at shipped defaults Ghostty 1.4.0 on macOS raises nothing a run can read when OSC 133;D arrives, so the cell is undecidable without a user config change. Traced in tag v1.4.0 (SHA256 d692bb9b): src/terminal/osc.zig:1180 parses 133, the exit code is an option of that parser (src/terminal/osc/parsers/semantic_prompt.zig:77-111), src/terminal/stream_terminal.zig:918-965 passes it to the effect callback, src/termio/stream_handler.zig:1475-1508 turns end_command into stop_command at :1493, and src/Surface.zig:1198-1225 emits command_finished with the exit code and the measured duration. The Mac app returns immediately on the shipped default: macos/Sources/Ghostty/Ghostty.App.swift:1642-1712 reads notifyOnCommandFinish and returns when it is never (src/config/Config.zig:1214), the action defaults to bell without notify (:1228) behind a five-second floor (:1265), and only a user setting that gate reaches the bell or a UNUserNotificationCenter banner (:1599,:1620) outside the text cells and window screenshot the run measures. The D mark and the A/B/C cycle are stored as row content, visible only to the debug inspector (src/inspector/widgets/page.zig:291 via src/input/Binding.zig:688-691) and the snapshot serializer (src/terminal/snapshot/grid.zig:259), neither of which is a default-launch reader. The only readback route needs notify-on-command-finish set away from never, which changes what Ghostty does when a command ends (a bell or a notification banner), so it is a behaviour setting, not an observer-only switch (@cto 9de3bba2).
